Subject: End of term true-up and final invoice request

Hi Mina,

We're closing out the April 2026–Mar 2027 contract term and need the true-up/invoice for the overage usage and credits applied during the term. Can you send us: a single final amount or a two-installment plan option, line-item breakdown (compute hrs, storage, support credits), and VAT treatment for our EU subsidiary (Greenleaf EU B.V., VAT NL123456789).

I've attached the invoices our audit team pulled for reference (Greenleaf_Q1_Audit_Invoices.zip) — it shows the billing lines that need to align. We also need the invoice to reference our PO number (PO-7889) so internal routing is smooth.

Target: we need the final invoice(s) by 2027-04-18 so treasury can schedule payment in April. If a staggered plan is necessary, please propose dates and any finance charges.

Thanks,

VP, Finance Operations
Greenleaf Health

Short answer: we can do a two-installment (staggered) plan and we will provide a line-item true-up breakdown. Proposal below:
- Invoice A (immediate) — includes licensing + overage through 2027-03-31, due 2027-04-30
- Invoice B (follow) — deferred portion (if you prefer cash smoothing), due 2027-06-15

A couple of clarifying asks before we lock amounts:
1) Confirm whether Greenleaf EU B.V. should receive a separate invoice (VAT NL123456789) or whether you prefer a single invoice with VAT split lines.
2) Confirm the PO-7889 billing contact and whether we should add "Attn: Accounts Payable — Emma Jones" on the PDF.

I've attached a draft schedule (Draft_TrueUp_Schedule.pdf) that shows the suggested split and dates. Marcus / Laura — can you run the final tax calc and confirm if we should apply VAT on Invoice A or split by entity?

Best,
Mina Haddad

2) PO-7889 should be referenced on both invoices. Billing contact: Accounts Payable — ap@greenleaf.io (cc'd on the finance address).
3) No finance charges if Invoice A is paid by 2027-04-30; if Invoice B is paid after 2027-07-01, standard late fees apply.

I'm attaching a scanned PO for your records (PO-7889.pdf). If you can send the two PDFs by 2027-04-15 we can schedule payment for Invoice A in the next AR run.
